outcomes.text: In any Viam-using shop, a batch of new x86 machines and Pis comes back as named hosts online in Viam, with nobody at a console.
outcomes.signal: after the one-time BIOS setup, a batch of ten reaches installed and shows online at app.viam.com, with no monitor or keyboard attached during the run

outcomes.text: Someone trusted to run a server on the shop's LAN sets one up once; after that, anyone in the shop provisions and watches batches from their own Mac or iPhone.
outcomes.signal: a provisioner who never touched the server Mac provisions a machine and watches it reach installed from their own device
